name: A Climbing Game
summary:
# What will you find on top of the tower? 🧗🏿‍♀️

Climb climb climb! Get your pick axes and use them to climb as fast as possible on top of the mountain. How fast can you go?

Stick to the rocks, stick to the windmill, ride the ropes, and be the first to climb as high as possible.🔔
